scope: Reconstruction knowledge established by admitted evidence in this repository. Rules are attached to worker packets when their triggers apply; they guide declarations and expression forms, never relax proof.

rules.rule: LINK 5.30 /FARCALLTRANSLATION rewrites a same-segment far call into NOP; PUSH CS; CALL near (five bytes). Write an ordinary far call to the named function; the strict matcher validates the linker transformation independently.

Declaration order can determine DS versus ES code generation: the compiler keeps the last-loaded far selector live, so the order in which far objects are first referenced in the source (not the extern declaration order) fixes ES reuse and the CONST selector-pool order. Reorder references, not declarations, to change selector traffic.

Two or more named ant-list fields use the same segment-8 selector slot in this function. This establishes a shared segment selector here, not that the fields are one Dx8 array. Use each observed displacement and retain separate object identities unless unit evidence establishes an alias.

When the historical code holds a parameter's value in SI/DI throughout, an explicit local copy of the parameter (register variable candidate) can be required; the compiler does not enregister [bp+n] parameters directly.

A historical return tail of the form MOV DX,1 / MOV AX,... (or a result set on several paths) is reproduced by an explicit result variable assigned on each path and returned once, not by multiple return statements.

Arrays are frequently word-indexed (SHL 1 / ADD reg,reg before the displacement). Preserve the observed element width: declare int arrays for two-byte strides, char arrays for byte strides, eight-byte structs for SHL 3.

Never invent a convenient symbol when MAPSYM provides the real one: use the exact name from direct_data_bindings; an unnamed operand inside a named public array is an index into that array, not a new private object.

A matching numeric offset does not establish object identity: equal offsets in different segments are different objects, and a BSS word placed by constraint inside another object's data proves nothing.

Far-object identity requires selector/segment evidence: an NE selector relocation on the slot or immediate that loads ES, resolved to the object's segment. Prefer the packet's addressed_segment and exact_mapsym_names.

Reconstruct private state as natural static data with an evidence-backed size, type and initializer (a static in _DATA when the original bytes are initialised, in _BSS only when the original word lies in the BSS region), never as address-padding arrays.

Preserve an already matching function body while solving its translation-unit or data binding: DATA_LAYOUT / PRIVATE_CONST_LAYOUT blockers are unit-assembly work (tools/tu_assembly.py), not body rewrites.

The CONST selector pool is private to one object and ordered by first reference across the whole unit; a function whose pool constraints conflict in isolation needs its unit context, and functions sharing a pool word belong to the same unit.

The compiler profile belongs to the unit context (layout/compiler-profiles.json): use the packet profile as given; a code-shape mismatch that only /Og explains is profile evidence for the unit (report it), not a per-function flag to try.

Inline REP STOSW/MOVSW from simple loops and struct copies are ordinary /Oelw code; REPNE SCASB (strlen) or REP MOVSB over a computed length are /Oi intrinsic fingerprints and count as profile evidence for the unit rather than as hand-written loops.

MSC 7 compiles a dense `switch` into `cmp ax,N; ja default; shl ax,1; xchg bx,ax; jmp word ptr cs:[bx+T]` with the N+1 case offsets stored as `dw` rows right after the jump (the packet shows them as `dw offset X`; the cases are `sub`-normalised so `sub ax,5; cmp ax,8` means cases 5..13 with holes pointing at `default`). Write a plain `switch` on the value with exactly those case labels; holes are absent cases, shared targets are fall-through or identical labels, `default:` only when the ja target does real work. Case body order follows the source order; `break` tails become `jmp` to the common exit and each body except the last is followed by an alignment `nop`. Sparse switches compile to compare chains instead; do not force a table.

Dx8 (segment 8 offset 0) and Dy8 (offset 8) are two MAPSYM symbols; in objects whose pool block holds two adjacent segment-8 words for them (simtwo:3EF8 C57E/C580, simant:6A38 BF70/BF72) index each with the bare direction (`Dx8[i]`, `Dy8[i]`), never `Dy8[i+8]` or `(Dx8+8)`; one word per symbol. The one-Dx8-object spelling applies only where a single word serves all displacements.

Values computed only to feed a call are emitted in argument push order (right to left), not statement order: when the target loads `Dy8` before `Dx8` the call is `f(..., lx, ly)` with ly the last argument. Reorder arguments/locals before rewriting expressions.
YMapPopB (seg 8 +0xA4) and YMapPopR (+0x164) are 12x16 byte maps indexed `(x << 4) + y`, each through its own selector word; the symbol supplies the base displacement (do not add 0xA4/0x164).

struct OpenDB (PACK _openDBData, 0x7C-byte slots): name[0x50]; void far *indexTable @0x50; int recordCount @0x54; pad to 0x6C; int count @0x6C; long freeBytes @0x6E; long wastedBytes @0x72; int pad @0x76 (never referenced); int file @0x78; int dirty @0x7A. Deleted/replaced record lengths are added to wastedBytes.

Never reach a PACK word as `match_position[K]`: the object allocates one selector word per symbol, so the public at PACK offset 2K (`ListIndexB`, `TemBModePop[i]`, `FlyAwayR`, ...) must be named; `tools/rebind_pack_index.py` rewrites and re-verifies such sources. Isolated admissions with this spelling are byte-exact but bind the wrong word in the unit.

In simant1:0000 the A-list fields are the public arrays AlistX/AlistY/AlistM/AlistT/AlistS addressed as `__based(__segname("SIMANT_DATA_GROUP"))` (one segment word C318 with absolute displacements 0x23A4/0x2B78/0x2F62), while Dx8/Dy8 keep their own words (C31E/C31C). `tools/rebind_based_fields.py` rewrites `Dx8[i + 0xOFF]` spellings. Members that load the segment immediately (DoDefendNest) use no pool word and keep their spelling.

When `_IsValidA` and `_GoInNest` bracket the target's CX zero/one flag sequence, the target carries a hole result through a shared check before the GoInNest path. As a source-shape experiment, initialize one flag to zero, set it on the terrain-specific hole cases, and use an explicit `goto` to the shared test from early invalid/alternate branches; a direct `if (hole) return` may schedule the call block too early. This improved `_DoToAlarm` from 225/248 opcodes at 678 bytes to 227/248 at the exact 682-byte extent, but strict proof still fails. Recheck each target's branch graph and semantics.

In gr:7712, selector BF78 reaches a zero-initialized SIMANT_DATA_GROUP state at 8D08. The admitted fourteen-member unit matches a 22-byte shared declaration through 8D1D, including moduleHandle (+0), waveHandle (+0xC), refCount (+0x12), and songState (+0x14). Its source uses a const __segment selector word and a based view of the same state object; the representation matches all claimed bodies and private contributions, without proving historical identifier or macro spelling. snd_IsSongDone's target CMP 1; SBB AX,AX; NEG AX is emitted by songState == 0 under C7. MultiMediaSong independently uses the same selector view and fields at 8D08/0A/0C/0E. DGROUP 0AF4 is the MAPSYM word wSoundBlasterMsg, not a string-table base. The fourteen-member unit shares named near arrays for the procedure names at 0AFA/0B0C and two system paths at 0B1E/0B32, while CheckMMWave's MMSYSTEM.DLL remains a literal at odd 0B47. A source-local strlen intrinsic under the baseline flags emits CheckMMWave's inline scan; KERNEL ordinal 134 is GetWindowsDirectory. These are evidenced for this unit, not a blanket object or compiler-profile rule. Preserve object and literal identities when extending the unit; test each new member and its private contributions independently.

MSC 7 orders the operands of a commutative expression of two globals by their declaration order (the earlier-declared symbol becomes the second/memory operand: `tileWidth * editWidth` -> `mov ax,[tileWidth]; imul [editWidth]` requires editWidth declared before tileWidth). Rewriting the expression does not help (the compiler canonicalises it); the fix is declaration order. Isolated candidates: reorder externs. Units: record the pair in layout/declaration-order.json (applied by tu_assembly.compose).
